shared_elements: carved marks arranged in a horizontal register or row
repeated small motifs across a rock/stone surface
justification: Both surfaces carry carved marks organised broadly into horizontal bands, and both include small repeated units strung along a line, which is about as generic a correspondence as carving can offer. A shows a sparse, linear, schematic pecked motif (a long shaft with a row of short strokes, like a boat or comb form) on an otherwise open rock face, while B shows a dense, deeply modelled composition of interlocking curvilinear glyph-like and face-like elements filling the whole field with volumetric relief; no specific motif, posture or relationship is shared.
